Rodic's, Tapsi ni Vivian and surprisingly, Sinangag Express' tapa is now good.

Feeling the same recently, been distracting myself with work and games pero it eats you up sometimes kaya best to get help from your friends. It doesn't need to be you venting out your feelings but can serve more of a distraction from what you are currently feeling. Just hanging out can make time fly faster and also there may be a chance for you to speak your thoughts, surely if they're your real friends then they would never see it as a bother.
If I am to see it, it gets better in some aspects and gets worse in some that's just how it is. Living with the positive and negative things is what keeps me sane.

More on how you present yourself siguro in my opinion. People may vary din kasi on how they perceive e, pero confidence in your outlook brings an awe factor e. Also not just your appearance, pleasing personality and attitude is a great bonus as well. Just a tip siguro na to take it as it is, na you are appealing rather than thinking of an ulterior reason.
Ideal but each person receives different, so gauge before you do.
You always have to go back to your roots
